messages:
claire: Quick chase — PM follow-up for RED-2101 shows three action items overdue. Need owners to confirm status or handoff today so we can close the loop. This incident is listed as a repeat pattern in the chapter notes.

devin: I own RED-7420 (add autoscaler safeguards). WIP, blocked on perf data from staging. I should have the dataset by EOD.

ryan: I own RED-7455 (ramp limits + alert tuning). Draft PR open but still need to coordinate alert thresholds with SRE.

oncall-bot: Reminder: RED-7420 due 2026-04-08 (assigned to devin). RED-7455 due 2026-04-07 (assigned to ryan).

claire: If either of you cannot resolve by EOD, please set the ticket to "Needs Reassign" and ping me. We prefer handoff to avoid stale PM items.

devin: Perf dump uploaded to staging bucket s3://redwood-staging/perf/red-2101/20260401. Noticed higher tail latency; filing RED-7480 to track root cause analysis.

ryan: PR ready for review: https://git.redwood.ai/pull/8912. I also updated alert docs at https://wiki.redwood.ai/alerts/db-pool. Need @devin to confirm safe threshold before merge.

oncall-bot: Auto-check: RED-7420 status changed to "In Review" by devin.

ops-bot: FYI quota change INC-5601 applied to prod-gpupool by ops. See change log entry 2026-04-01T15:12Z.

claire: Thanks for updates. Devin, confirm whether the perf data implies we should increase min instances or adjust scale trigger. Ryan, if alert thresholds need to be relaxed temporarily please document the risk and add a rollback note.

devin: After looking at the dump, we should nudge min_instances + auto-scaling cooldown. I'll open a small config PR and tag ops for a coordinated deploy. ETA 2 hrs.

ryan: I'll hold the PR merge until devin's config change is in. Added a runbook note in RED-7455 under "temporary mitigations".

claire: Good. Two final asks for closure: 1) paste commit hashes in the tickets; 2) add a one-line verification step for SRE to mark done (e.g., "no connection errors for 72h at production traffic").

devin: Config PR merged: commit abc123ef. Updated RED-7420 with commit and verification step.

ryan: Merged alert tuning PR: commit f4d2b9a. Updated RED-7455 with commit and verification step. Marked ticket resolved and left cross-link to RED-7480.

oncall-bot: Postmortem follow-up automation: RED-2101 cluster marked READY_FOR_CLOSE pending SRE verification.

claire: I'm assigning to @oncall (SRE) to verify the 72h no-error window. If verified, I'll close the PM tracker.

oncall-bot: SRE verification scheduled — automatic check in 72h.

claire: One more note for the record: team will include a monthly capacity sanity check to detect the slow-building pattern noted in the PM. Adding RED-7499 to represent that recurring review.

oncall-bot: Action: RED-2101 PM actions cleared for follow-up; pending verification.

devin: Thanks team. If anything pops up I'll reopen the ticket.

ryan: Thanks, closing my side.

claire: Closing thread once SRE verifies. If no issues, I'll mark closed on 2026-04-05.
